description_sq:
• Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 tualete tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, ne katin e 5 te nje objekti te ri, i pajisur me ashensor. Apartamenti disponon nje Sipërfaqe 141.4m2 bruto dhe Sipërfaqe 118.4m2 neto.
I organizuar ne nje Ambjent ndenje, pjesa e gatimit e veçuar, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon me pamje te lire.
Rezidenca ju ofron facilitete, qetësi, ajër i pastër dhe parkim per banoret rezident (me pages mujore). Prona disponon Certificate.
Apartamenti ju ofron hapsira te bollshme, pamje te lire dhe eshte lehtesisht i konvertueshëm ne Apartament 3+1+2 tualete. 
Pronesie. Cmimi i Apartamentit eshte 250,000€. Per nje vizite me kontaktoni !
description_en: • Apartment for sale, 2+1+2 bathrooms, at Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, on the 5th floor of a new building, equipped with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​141.4m2 and a net area of ​​118.4m2. Organized in a living room, separate kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony with a free view. The residence offers facilities, tranquility, fresh air and parking for residents (with monthly payment). The property has a certificate. The apartment offers you ample spaces, a clear view and is easily convertible into a 3+1+2 bathroom apartment. Property. The price of the Apartment is €250,000. Contact me for a visit!
